name: Take Home Pozole
description: A prepackaged cold 32oz quart to reheat at home, toppings included, delivered or picked up.
longDescription: The same family recipe as the hot version, sealed in a prepackaged 32oz container and kept cold for delivery or pickup, ready to reheat at home. Pork, chicken, or vegan, in White, Red, or Green. Toppings are included in every order, packed in their own separate to-go containers so nothing gets soggy in transit, cabbage, radishes, onions, jalapenos, cilantro, oregano, red pepper flakes, limes, and avocado. This is not the same product as the retail pouches sold in grocery stores, this is made to order and shipped directly.

variants.label: Take-Home (32oz)
variants.note: Prepackaged cold quart to reheat at home. Toppings and salsa styles packaged separately to add as you enjoy your Pozole
